messages:
devx-zoe: Starting a micro-refresh of the Hello World quickstart focused on auth hygiene and first-deploy clarity. Scope: replace long-lived browser key example with a server-mediated ephemeral flow, bump SDK snippets to v5, and correct the live-deploy checklist link.

pat: nice. can we make the ephemeral server example language-agnostic? a tiny JS example plus a note for Python/Go would be great.

leo: agree with pat. also add a short security rationale line (revoke ability + no leaked envs).

devx-zoe: good call. PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/starterkit/pull/402 (docs-only). changed: quickstart/README.md, examples/ephemeral.md, docs/migration_v4_to_v5.md

amy: I'll review the SDK bits. quick question: are we standardizing on 'RedwoodClient' constructor for v5?

devx-zoe: yes, v5 uses RedwoodClient. sample client snippet in quickstart:```
// client-side after server exchange
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: ephemeralKey });
const out = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood/fast-1', input: 'hello' });
```

pat: for server snippet leaving env var note: `const token = process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY // keep long-lived key on server` and a one-line curl example for Python/Go users.

devx-zoe: added both. ephemeral TTL guidance: ops recommends 10m for interactive tutorials; I set example to 5m for brevity and documented tradeoffs.

doc-bot: PR 402: docs lint OK, accessibility check flagged header contrast on the new note (minor). https://ci.redwood-inference.dev/checks/402

ci-bot: preview deployed to docs-preview: https://docs-preview.redwood-inference.dev/starterkit/402

deploy-bot: netlify preview: https://deploy-preview-402--starterkit.netlify.app/hello-world

amy: left two tiny wording suggestions on the PR (initialize vs instantiate, and a comma). nothing blocking.

leo: LGTM from security after TTL note and env var guidance.

devx-zoe: thanks! plan to merge tomorrow noon PT unless other feedback. adding a one-line "what changed" at top per request. :sparkles:

pat: :thumbsup:
notes: micro-refresh for quickstart auth + sdk v5 snippets
